sloka: बभूव परमप्रीता सिद्धिं प्राप्येव मन्थरा ।अथ सा रुषिता देवी सम्यक्कृत्वा विनिश्चयम् ॥२-१०-५॥
transliteration: babhūva paramaprītā siddhiṁ prāpyeva mantharā ।atha sā ruṣitā devī samyakkṛtvā viniścayam ॥2-10-5॥

translations.english: Then Kaikeyi finally took a firm decision. With a soiled body and a frowning face she lay down on the floor.
